# Founders Network / Founder Institute

A community: self-promotion is judged by tone and by whether you are a real member.

## Steps
1. Open https://fi.co/ and read the rules (sidebar, wiki, FAQ or guidelines).
2. Write a post for this specific audience from `copy.reddit_post` / `copy.launch_post_story`, following skill/human-writing.
3. `launchkit draft founders-network-founder-institute -` with title, body, flair and best posting time, then `launchkit mark founders-network-founder-institute drafted`.
4. Only if `launch_settings.allow_social_posting` is true and the user approved this draft: post it, then mark `submitted --listing-url <post url>`.
